set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-maintenance.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Extract one private codec quoted-TSV/v1 writer shared by MappingExchange and StoryModelExport. Preserve both committed bundle byte sets and both independent Python readers; avoid unrelated wire/API changes.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

FOLLOW-UP (T4) from S5 (bd-01M19XMQN4VK4WSTVSHBD3X1YB). ADR 0020 §8 copies MappingExchange's private CellType/Column/Table/quote/validUtf16 into StoryModelExport, to avoid editing G2's file during the push. Two copies of one wire can drift.

Acceptance: a private[codec] quoted-TSV/v1 writer used by both. Byte-identical output for both bundles: the committed examples/mapping/miniature and examples/storymodel-export/war-of-the-ghosts must be unchanged, and both Python readers must pass. Coordinate with the mapping exchange owner before editing mappingexchange.scala.
